text:
claire: Heads-up: RC candidate rc-2026.03.22 hung on SBOM verification and vuln gate. Deploy-bot shows transitive infra advisory and cosign timestamp didn't attach. Change window closes at 17:30 PDT. We need a decision: hold, pin digest + NA carveout, or proceed with sandbox and delayed EU.

diego: paste the deploy output pls

deploy-bot: [automated] deploy:rc-2026.03.22 | state: blocked | reasons: sbom_provenance_missing, vuln: INFRA-HIGH-2026-072 | image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34ef

sigbot: vuln summary: INFRA-HIGH-2026-072 -> glibc-allocator patch; severity=high; exploit vector: local->container breakout; repro: intermittent; mitigations: kernel/glibc backport OR runtime seccomp+mitigations (perf hit ~2-6%). SBOM signer: cosign timestamp absent; keyserver reported degraded.

nina: if keyserver is flaky that's an availability problem. We can do a controlled NA-only carveout and pin the digest. We MUST get security signoff and legal ok for EU delay.

security: security: prefer waiting if ETA < 1h. If not, NA carveout + runtime hardening flag (SECURE_MODE=1) + limited traffic is acceptable with engineering+security signoff documented.

legal: legal: require explicit customer messaging for any regional carveout, plus internal approval doc. We'll prepare a short blurb; engineering needs to attach the artifact digest and note the cosign follow-up.

infra: infra: route suggestion -> set header-based canary: `env.region in ("us-west-*,us-east-*") AND header.x-release-canary=="rc-2026.03.22"` and flip feature toggle `allow_eu_canary=false` until proven. I can push that rule in 5m.

claire: proposal: 45m timebox to wait for cosign evidence. If none, pin digest and roll NA-only canary with SECURE_MODE enabled, 20% traffic ramp over 15 minutes, 2h monitor with alert thresholds for error rate and p95 latency. Immediate rollback to rc-2026.03.21 on breach. We'll annotate release notes and open follow-up ticket to attach provenance and schedule patch if backport needed.

diego: agree. commands:```
# pin and annotate
deploy-bot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34ef --note="sbom-provenance-delay" --ttl=4h
# apply carveout rule (infra)
```

nina: i'll draft release note blurb: "rc-2026.03.22 - North America limited canary due to artifact provenance delay; runtime secure mode enabled to mitigate a transitive infra advisory. Artifact provenance will be attached post-signing and a follow-up patch scheduled if necessary." I'll link to confluence after legal review.

sigbot: auto: monitoring recipe suggestion: add lightweight fuzz and syscall blocking checks during canary; enable metric `canary.secure_mode.cpu_delta` to watch perf hit.

claire: starting 45m wait now. tagging @security @legal for signoffs.

sigbot: signer poll +20m: keyserver retries ongoing; cosign timestamp still not present. next poll +5m.

claire: ping infra to prep route rule and feature flag

infra: route and flag ready in staging, will push to prod if we pin.

sigbot: signer poll +46m: no cosign evidence; keyserver FYI: degraded with unknown ETA.

claire: timebox reached. i'm pinning and requesting NA-only rollout.

claire: `deploy-bot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34ef --note="sbom-provenance-delay" --ttl=4h` -> done

deploy-bot: pinned=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34ef | ttl=4h | scheduled: canary in 10m | policy: region==us-* && header.x-release-canary=="rc-2026.03.22" | secure_mode=on

infra: pushed route and flipped `allow_eu_canary=false`. Starting low ramp now. Grafana board: https://grafana.redwood/d/rc-2026.03.22-canary

sigbot: run: smoke + syscall checks -> first 10 mins show increased syscalls blocked, CPU +5%. No errors yet.

diego: i've kicked quick chaos smoke. No obvious anomalies first 7m.

legal: draft customer message is ready, tagging product for review. Will send to EU customers if carveout persists beyond 8h.

sigbot: signer poll +3h: cosign evidence posted for ab12cd34ef. Attaching provenance to artifact ticket now.

claire: cosign timestamp found. plan: after verifying attached provenance and validating canary metrics for 1h, we'll promote to EU/global. Unpin will be scheduled at pin TTL or earlier on promote.

security: ack. please paste provenance link when ready. We'll audit manifest afterwards.

legal: sending EU notification now and closing action item for customer comms.

infra: monitoring steady. no alerts.

claire: thanks team. final steps: update release notes with digest and provenance link, close follow-up ticket when provenance attached and patch plan (if any) created. I'll close thread after updates.
